name: LocalBeat
description: LocalBeat lets Claude search local entertainment and recreation anywhere in the US by place, date, and event type. It pulls together events that are otherwise scattered across individual venue and organizer pages: live music, trivia nights, open mics, comedy, karaoke, markets, festivals, classes, fitness, kids and family programs, and community gatherings. Search by city, ZIP, or coordinates with natural-language dates like "this weekend" or "next Friday," filter by event type, and get venue addresses, times, and ticket links.

_published_faq.name: How do I add LocalBeat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add LocalBeat to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://localbeat.com/api/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the LocalBeat MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: LocalBeat provides these MCP tools: get_event_details, get_search_facets, and search_events.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to LocalBeat?
